meta.title: Spain 2026 Family Trip
meta.note: Times use explicit offsets: +02:00 = Spain (CEST), -04:00 = US Eastern (EDT).

events.title: JetBlue 1506: Nashville → Boston
events.description: Confirmation QYKBMM. Williams family outbound leg 1.

events.title: JetBlue 2261: Boston → Madrid
events.description: Overnight flight. Arrives Madrid Barajas ~11:30 AM Spain time May 27.

events.title: Arrive Madrid Barajas
events.description: Customs and luggage. Cercanías C1 to Atocha (~25 min).

events.title: Train: Madrid → Valencia (AVE 05990)
events.description: Locator 4XYBG8. Atocha → Valencia Joaquín Sorolla. Premium Confort. Club Lounge from 17:40.

events.title: Check in: Valencia beach house
events.description: Vrbo HA-7TLM9D. Grandmother's house next to the beach. Host Maria Pilar. Crib confirmed for Harlan.

events.title: Deadline: Valencia police guest form
events.description: Required by Spanish law before arrival. Form: heavenonearth.es/docpolicial/indexen.php?id=MTEwOTI=

events.title: Paella lunch — Restaurante Casa Carmela
events.description: Booked for 1:00 PM Spain time. Carrer d'Isabel de Villena, 155.

events.title: Leave Valencia (early checkout / bag hold)
events.description: Vrbo checkout is 11:00 but train is 09:06. Leave ~07:45; ask host Maria Pilar to hold bags or confirm early checkout.

events.title: Train: Valencia → Barcelona (Euromed 01092)
events.description: Locator 9D2RJU. Estació del Nord → Barcelona-Sants. Coach 13.

events.title: Check in: Barcelona apartment
events.description: Vrbo 726EF3C0B8. Luxury Apartment on Valencia Street (Williams family).

events.title: Wedding Event #1
events.description: Gothic Quarter. Confirm exact time/location from wedding details.

events.title: Morning Tour Group A: La Pedrera & Sagrada
events.description: Meet outside La Pedrera, Passeig de Gràcia 92. Updated start 9:15 AM.

events.title: Sagrada Família entry
events.description: Locator 97232969. Entry C/ Marina. Sagrada Família Oficial app + photo ID required.

events.title: Evening Tapas Tour
events.description: Meet at Grand Hotel Central. Wedding-organized evening tapas tour.

events.title: Wedding Day
events.description: Main wedding day. Gothic Quarter.

events.title: Check out: Barcelona apartments
events.description: Return Casa Gay suit if rented. Store bags via Stasher or Barcelona-Sants lockers until train.

events.title: Train: Barcelona → Madrid (AVE 03152)
events.description: Locator JKSS7B. Barcelona-Sants → Madrid Atocha. Coach 1.

events.title: Arrive Madrid Airbnb
events.description: Airbnb HMR8NYWPZF. Earliest check-in 15:00; group arrives ~19:00 after AVE. Crib confirmed for Harlan.

events.title: Thomas family departs Madrid
events.description: DL0063 Madrid → Boston. Taxi ~12:00–12:30 PM from Airbnb.

events.title: Check out: Madrid Airbnb
events.description: Store bags via Stasher La Latina/Sol or Airbnb partner storage before flight.

events.title: Williams family departs Madrid
events.description: JetBlue 2260 Madrid → Boston. Taxi ~12:00–12:15 PM from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: L'Oceanogràfic (aquarium)
suggestions.description: Europe's largest aquarium. Host Maria Pilar offers discounted skip-the-line tickets.

suggestions.title: Mercado Central
suggestions.description: Open Mon–Sat 7:30 AM–3:00 PM. Great for May 28 flexible morning.

suggestions.title: Malvarrosa Beach
suggestions.description: 3–5 min walk from beach house. Pool at house too.

suggestions.title: Park Güell
suggestions.description: Timed entry required. Book at parkguell.barcelona.

suggestions.title: Gothic Quarter walk
suggestions.description: Wedding venue area. Explore between check-in and Event #1.

suggestions.title: Casa Gay suit fitting
suggestions.description: Roger de Llúria 12-14. Fitting May 29 afternoon; return June 1 AM.

suggestions.title: Retiro Park
suggestions.description: Rowboats, Crystal Palace. Good post-wedding relax day.

suggestions.title: Prado Museum
suggestions.description: Free 6–8 PM Mon–Sat. Book ahead for daytime visit.

suggestions.title: La Latina tapas crawl
suggestions.description: Walking distance from Airbnb. Cava Baja street.

luggageGaps.recommendation: Atocha consigna (~€5–6/bag) or Stasher near Retiro. Club Lounge from 17:40 with Premium ticket.
Ask host Maria Pilar to hold bags / early checkout. Stasher near Estació del Nord if needed.
Lunch near apartment with light bags. Stasher at Sants if heavy.
Stasher near Gothic Quarter or Barcelona-Sants lockers (~€6–10/day). Return Casa Gay suit AM.
Stasher La Latina/Sol (~€3.49/bag) or Airbnb partner luggage storage (15% off).
